name: Hurley Metal Fabrication & MFG
old_description: Hurley Metal Fabrication & MFG specializes in critical tolerance projects at competitive pricing. Short runs, long runs, punching, forming, welding… Hurley can be your one source for all metal fabrication demands.
about:
Hurley Metal Fabrication & Manufacturing operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in Windsor, Connecticut. The company has been in business since 1995, building a reputation as a job shop for critical-tolerance sheet metal work.

The shop provides a full range of sheet metal fabrication services, including fiber laser cutting up to 1.125-inch thick, five-axis water jet cutting up to six inches thick, tube laser cutting, press brake forming to 330 tons, punching, hardware insertion, plate rolling, and sawing with CNC gauging accuracy of 0.005 inch. Welding capabilities cover MIG, TIG, fiber optic laser, and advanced precision welding. Finishing options include polishing, brushing, coating, plating, deburring, and cleaning. The 15-plus technicians handle prototype through production volumes, producing frames, panels, tubing, tooling, computer chassis, enclosures, material handling equipment, stainless steel food processing equipment, and cosmetic and architectural projects.

Hurley serves commercial clients across architectural, automotive, and OEM product manufacturing sectors, with additional work in food processing and cosmetic industries.

The company emphasizes strong project management, consistent communication, quality craftsmanship, and top-of-the-line equipment as its differentiators, and offers expedited turnaround times, product traceability, and materials management through its Unitower storage system.
